method: Started from the adopted OER and reconstructed article 11.3 by unique compulsory row and credits, then cross-checked the annual catalogue and exact skills, procedure, moot court and thesis entries. Revisited the UCR workbook and both candidate schedules before matching the findings against the finished decision, canonical bytes and audience renderer field paths.
findings: 60+60+60 EC. First-year property and family law are each 3 EC. The ordinary third-year thesis and moot court count once each at 6 EC. Catalogue duplicates are parallel course codes. The OU bridging thesis, separately listed internship and honours are not required in addition. An open 30 EC block is real elective space.

Article 9.1 links advanced administrative, contract, property, criminal and constitutional law and legal encyclopedia to their respective foundations, and European fundamental rights to both European and constitutional law foundations. The thesis assessment requires 120 EC including Legal Skills. Moot court requires 99 EC including Legal Skills. The illustrated sequence reaches both thresholds after two years.

Articles 12.1 and 12.2 allow approved minors, faculty exchanges and coherent course packages. Exchange and coherent package conditions include at most 6 EC at level 100 and at least 12 EC at level 300. Eligible VU university minors and listed faculty minors can be taken without prior examination-board permission, subject to admission rules.

UCR’s comparative contract and property analysis, constitutional remedies, and criminal liability work are genuine disciplinary contributions. The climate direction also has concrete regulatory material. Neither tested 180 EC route supplies the cumulative Dutch doctrinal and procedural training or culminating legal skills. Offering conflicts in the old proposal did not determine the result.
